fact: The Accounts Office director general said the office has begun adopting IPSAS through the government financial information system GIFIMS and has sent two payroll computerisation systems to the National Information Centre for one to be approved in the plan to mechanise payroll sheets.
title: ديوان الحسابات يؤكد العمل على ربط الولايات بنظام التحصيل الإلكتروني "إيصالي"
